title: Upper Bound for the Run Value
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols and let $x$ be a Boolean input. For any nonnegative integer $K$, if the probability that $N$ accepts on a uniformly random choice word of length $K$ is at most $1/3$, then the run value with the rejecting decision rule, $K$ blocks, initial count $0$, and parameter $i=K+1$ is at most $2(8/9)^{ loor{(K+1)/2}}$.
